{{Quote|We can't let that upstart Baron Munsk top our traditional gunfa race! Let's make ours even bigger and better!|A Tapani noble|<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>}}
A '''gunfa race''' was a traditional social event that was held in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. [[Noble/Legends|Nobles]] from the [[Tapani Noble Houses|Great Houses]] often competed amongst themselves to hold the best gunfa race.<ref name="LE" />
